text:
Elaine: Hey team — opened a small PR to add LATAM + MEA rows to the region availability matrix and a short data-residency note for Brazil (customers asking). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2045. Also added Go + Python SDK snippets for setting region headers, but I didn't touch Node yet. Can someone do a quick copy-edit and link-check?

Jordan: Looking now. Quick flag — we say "globally available" in one paragraph; that's inaccurate for preview regions. Suggest: "Available in preview in LATAM and MEA — contact sales for GA timing." Short and avoids legal.

Sophia: Re legal: we should not promise residency, only that data is routed to regional endpoints where supported. Proposed phrasing: "Regional endpoints route requests to the nearest serving region; data residency may be subject to local regulations and contracts. See compliance page." I'll paste suggested footnote to replace the current long legal paragraph.

Matt: Quick code snippets sanity check — the Go snippet I added is minimal but shows both client option and raw header. Do we want both? Example I put in PR:
```go
// client option
c := redwood.NewClient(redwood.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")), redwood.WithRegion("sa-east1"))
resp, err := c.Generate(ctx, prompt)

// raw HTTP header
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Region", "sa-east1")
```
Works locally. If you want a Node snippet I can add it after Jordan's copy edits.

Ian: Two infra things: 1) We need redirects for old endpoint docs that point to /v1/regions — I'll open redirect PR after this lands. 2) FYI some partner-facing links (support tickets) still reference `latam.redwood.ai` — we should add a short migration note for integrators.

linkcheck-bot: Run complete for PR 2045 — Found 1 broken internal link: /compliance/data-residency -> 404.

Elaine: Thanks — @Jordan can you do the copy edit (condense the matrix row text)? @Sophia please paste your legal footnote as a single sentence and point the compliance link to the new page. @Matt add Node snippet after your Go one. @Ian open redirects + migration note. I'm keeping the PR open for 24h for reviews.

Jordan: Will do a pass in ~30m. Leaving tiny inline comments on the PR now.

Sophia: Pasting suggested footnote for the PR: "Regional routing directs requests to regional serving endpoints where available; data residency depends on local regulations and contract terms — contact your account rep for guaranteed residency arrangements."

Matt: Added Node example as requested:
```js
// using official SDK
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, region: 'sa-east1' })
const resp = await client.generate({ prompt })

// raw fetch header
await fetch(url, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}`, 'X-Redwood-Region': 'sa-east1' } })
```

linkcheck-bot: Re-run after edits: compliance page still 404. Please create /compliance/data-residency or update link target.

docs-bot: Staging preview for PR 2045 deployed: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/pull/2045/preview (expires in 48h).

Ian: Created GH issue for redirects and left a note with ops to update partner docs. Issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/789

Elaine: Perfect — merging after Jordan's copy-edit + Sophia's footnote + link update. Thanks all :thumbsup:
